name: Free public transport in Tasmania
summary: Free travel for everyone on Tasmanian public buses, River Derwent ferries and Area Connect services until 30 June 2027.
key: Public transport is free until Wednesday, 30 June 2027.
catches: Pre-purchased Greencard or Transportme top-ups and 10-trip tickets can be used after 30 June 2027.

evidence.quote: Public transport is free until Wednesday, 30 June 2027.
This was initially scheduled to end on 30 June 2026 but has been extended by 12 months to 30 June 2027.
Free travel on public buses, River Derwent ferries, and Area Connect public transport services until 30 June 2027.
